description: Use this when a homeowner wants the monthly payment or total interest for an amount, rate and term, or to compare up to four what-ifs (another amount, rate or term, or a rate rise). Do not use for purchase mortgages, quotes to refinance the first mortgage (a rate-and-term or cash-out refinance), rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Amounts are US dollars and rates annual percent; any interest-only period comes first, then equal monthly payments of principal and interest. This is arithmetic on the figures given, not a lender's offer, and no APR is computed. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

scenarios.description: One to four loans to project.

annual_interest_rate_percent.description: The annual interest rate in percent, for example 7.5.

fees.description: One-time fees in US dollars, paid once and not financed. Leave out when unknown.

interest_only_months.description: Months of interest-only payments first, as in a HELOC's draw period (default 0).

product_type.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

repayment_months.description: Months of equal principal-and-interest payments, after any interest-only period.

stress_rate_percent.description: A higher annual rate in percent to test, for example after a variable rate rises.
